production_clock: Asia/Kolkata completed NSE session, not before 15:45
stage4a3_collection: frozen prospective_runner production path; existing snapshot never overwritten; a newly created snapshot is checked with a fresh post-subprocess UTC verification time
stage4a3_runtime_repo: explicit path to already activated checkout when current worktree lacks ignored prospective state; frozen integrity verified there
scanner: frozen build_signal_close_input(data_mode=REFRESH) reading the verified Stage 4A.3 snapshot's exact complete source cache with pandas float_precision=round_trip scoped only to its raw_market_data CSVs, followed by frozen normalize_source_candidate; a missing/empty source file fails before the builder can download
snapshot_input_cache: derive prospective/input_cache/YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ from verified Snapshot Created UTC under stage4a3_runtime_repo; no independent market refresh or fallback
candidate_provenance: exact immutable candidate manifest equality, including universe, raw/NIFTY/per-ticker hashes, candidate count, Signal-ID hash and full input hash; stable original market_data_manifest fields must match reconstructed values; report original provider identity
position_source: Stage 5D.2 derived positions and active pending reservations
management: Stage 5D.3 process_completed_session with actual NIFTY predecessor; holding observations reuse the same immutable Stage 4A.3 cache with round-trip CSV parsing, exact per-ticker raw-hash binding and frozen Stage 2.1 features; no holding-data download fallback
news: yfinance with explicit publication and acquisition timestamps; unusable articles quarantined, usable feed with quarantine remains AVAILABLE_WITH_QUARANTINE, zero usable evidence or provider failure is NEWS_DATA_UNAVAILABLE
overlay: Stage 5D.4 frozen overlay and read-only Stage 4A.3 shadow adapter
admission_requires_allocator_status: ACTIONABLE_BUY with recommended_quantity > 0; all other frozen allocator statuses are BLOCKED_ALLOCATOR_NOT_ACTIONABLE
paper_action_market_session: FILL and SELL validate internally: an existing same-day Stage 4A.3 snapshot is fully verified as stronger completed-session evidence; when no snapshot exists, the code-pinned, integrity-checked official NSE Capital Market 2026 calendar proves an ordinary scheduled session. A corrupt existing snapshot never falls back to the calendar. Unsupported years and special sessions fail closed. Validation is local and network-free; PENDING/CANCEL/DECLINE remain administrative.
paper_action_calendar: NSE_EQUITY_CALENDAR_V1; National Stock Exchange of India Limited; CAPITAL MARKET SEGMENT; NSE/CMTR/71775; circular 172/2025 dated 2025-12-12; canonical SHA-256 pinned in code
paper_buy: explicit paper_action only, through record_recommendation_fill; internally verified market-session fill date strictly after signal and decision dates and before that date's Stage 5D.3 management session
paper_sell: explicit user-recorded linked SELL only after internal market-session verification
same_session_successful_rerun: IDEMPOTENT_SUCCESS when scanner evidence hashes agree
historical_run_integrity: every Stage 5D.5 run row hash, canonical payload, all typed columns, unique ordered session dates, schema marker, SQLite integrity and foreign keys verified before a new production session; failure is LIVE_RUN_INTEGRITY_FAILURE
